highlights: The Green Lion Sydney Smart Glasses bring style, functionality, and new technology to make life easier.
The frame is made of a durable PC, and the UV400 polarized lenses ensure top eye protection for extended use, as they keep off the hazardous UV rays and blue light that cause eye strain.
The Bluetooth V5.4 allows seamless connectivity with an operation distance of 10 to 15m-to wear, call, listen to music, or interact with any device with it.
It also has a built-in speaker of size 9×16mm for crisp audio and a sensitivity of 78±3dB, while touch controls ensure that handling calls and playback is easy.

The smart glasses came powered by a 120mAh battery that will offer a maximum of 5 hours of talk time and 3-4 hours of music playing, which could be easily recharged via magnetic charging within 1.5 to 2 hours.
Equipped with IPX4 water-resistant technology, these glasses are able to resist splashes or light rain, hence very suitable for everyday wear.
